deadline.value: Apply by December 1, 2026. Attending an information session (November 4 or 11, 2026) earns a fee waiver code.
deadline.quote: This year's deadline for applications is Monday, December 1st, 2026.

also.quote: Attendees of the sessions will receive a fee waiver code after the session.

gre_general.value: The department says GRE scores are required but does not say which test, so check the portal for whether the Chemistry Subject test is expected.

gre_subject.value: The page does not name the Chemistry Subject test separately.

toefl_min.value: TOEFL iBT 90 overall, or IELTS 7.0 overall.
toefl_min.quote: The Department of Chemistry requires a minimum TOEFL score of 90 overall or a minimum IELTS scores of 7.0 overall.

ielts_min.value: IELTS Academic 7.0 overall, or TOEFL 90 overall.
ielts_min.quote: The Department of Chemistry requires a minimum TOEFL score of 90 overall or a minimum IELTS scores of 7.0 overall.

supervisor.value: You list faculty of interest on the application, but admission is not tied to a supervisor; lab rotations are available and most students pick an advisor by winter of the first year.
supervisor.quote: When applying online you will be asked to list faculty of interest before submitting your application.

also.quote: Most students select their research advisor by the winter quarter of their first year and are engaged in research by spring.

funding.value: Physical Sciences Division PhD admits are offered funding packages covering full tuition, health insurance and a stipend.
funding.quote: Applicants admitted to doctoral programs in the Physical Sciences Division are offered generous funding packages. | Offers include full tuition, student health insurance and student services fee coverage, and primary funding

entry_route.value: The pages do not say whether a master's degree is needed.

notes: The page calls December 1, 2026 a Monday; it is a Tuesday, so confirm the date on the portal. Info sessions are on November 4 and November 11, 2026.
